thread_title: S. flava var. cuprea (Bill Hoyer x Botanique)
breadcrumb: S. flava var. cuprea (Bill Hoyer x Botanique)

posts.body_html:
Here's another "cross" that's been performing year after year, yet a homie never got around to photo-documenting it until this morning! So what do you get when you mix up two really nice cupreas together? You get:
1) extreme vigor
2) very well defined coppery lids (with the help of selective pressure of course. Not all seedlings were great)
3) disease resistance. This cross is tough to kill and doesn't want to rot easily. It's also quite freeze tolerant, taking down to 21F without any damage whatsoever. It can probably take even cooler temperatures.
4) that's all I can think of, just wanted to add a number four to the list to make the list look longer

Okay, now that you've realized item #4 is Bull-own-knee, here are some nice pics to look at! Photos taken 5/22/23:


HOLY JESUS CRIES! Look at that color! That's the remixed phrase I've come up with so that if my kids repeat it, it doesn't get us in trouble, and we could just say that maybe Jesus was sad or something to that extent. In stark contrast, I think Jesus would be proud after seeing these crops:
